tagline: Climb an endless neon sky with rockets, gliders and gems.
description:
Ascend is an endless vertical climbing game. Jump from one glowing platform to the next and see how high you can get. Some platforms drift sideways and carry you with them.

Tap the middle of the screen to jump. Hold the left or right side to steer. Fall for two seconds and a parachute opens. Grab rocket pickups for a burst straight up, find a glider to float across gaps, and collect gems and coins. Every 30 gems or coins grants a power up. Wind gusts push you around while you are in the air.

The free demo climbs to 200m with every pickup and power up. Buy it to unlock the endless climb, including the cloud zone above 300m.

Plays in your phone or desktop browser. Arrow keys or WASD and Space work on a keyboard. Your best height is saved.
